adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23 that `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` allows any caller to pass an arbitrarily large limit value. While the default is 50, there's no server-side maximum enforcement. A malicious client could send limit=999999999 to force the server to load and serialize the entire group membership, potentially causing memory exhaustion. This is a real security/DoS vulnerability - the server should cap the limit to a reasonable maximum regardless of what the client requests.
